summary: Two women snowshoers lost on Spring Creek Road after missing the final turn to their parked car; called 911. A four-person OMRT team on a tracked snow machine located them via supplied coordinates and rode them back to the trailhead.
location: Spring Creek Road, NW Ouray County
notes: Located via phone coordinates; quick snow-machine ride to trailhead.
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: county (Ouray County, Colorado, United States)
